name: Large File Read
description: An agent auditing a large generated route file. The tool result carries a big synthetic file whose body contains two near-identical large blocks (content-addressable for L3 dedup) and whose line volume stresses read/smart-truncate handling; a follow-up grep returns a long repetitive match list (dedup-log shape). Full wire-body history per turn.

expect.intent: exercise large-tool-result handling: L3 content-address dedup and line/truncation compression on big synthetic file reads

turns.note: Agent starts the audit by reading the generated file.
